lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in near-vertical columns of 4 to 6 spots, positioned posterior to the branchial region and extending towards the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with circular blobs, creating a structured grid pattern where spots act as nodal points within the bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge feature is visible on the upper third of the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient running from the post-cranial region to the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 discrete high-luminance spots scattered across its lateral surface mask.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct white, highly reflective protrusion or marking is located at the distal apex of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple smaller fish silhouettes (remoras) are present, attached to or swimming closely beneath the ventral-lateral area of the shark.
